da-vacuous.notes: The §3b-cond 'audit-visibility stub' defines `class BorromeanQuark : Prop where holds : True` — an empty-marker class whose field is the tautology True (any instance ⟨trivial⟩ discharges it). The conditional theorem `q_beta_spectral_conditional [BorromeanQuark] (Q_beta_A Q_beta_B) : Q_beta_A = Q_beta_B := by sorry` is therefore a content-free conditional (it would 'prove' arbitrary reals equal, modulo a vacuous class) and is in any case left as `sorry`. This is exactly the empty-Prop-carrier anti-pattern §3b-tax forbids (proof-no-empty-prop-carrier).

da-circular.notes: The bridge derives Form A/Form B agreement from Taylor algebra, not from assuming the Q-value; no smuggled calibration in the algebraic core.

da-overclaim.notes: The .md states the bridge as an identity on the actual Q-values with an O(h²) remainder and an exponential per-N remainder bound. The exported Lean `q_beta_spectral_bridge` proves ONLY the three formal polynomial identities in abstract (h,z); it does NOT connect to Real.log(1+zh), to the Q_β observables, or to the exponential-remainder bound. The analytic content is instead asserted via two `axiom`s (log_one_add_lower_taylor_bound_axiom, log_one_add_taylor_bound_axiom). So the 'bridge proposition is rigorous' claim overstates what is proved: the analytic core is axiomatized, not derived (conditional/approximate-as-proved).

da-hidden-dof.notes: z and h are determined by q0; no off-menu coefficient. The block explicitly argues 1/z is the Markov–Jones normalization, not a calibration knob.

da-non-sequitur.notes: 'the proton-to-neutron conversion affects the two generators σ₀,σ₁ ... so the total log-ratio is 2·(zh/2)=zh' then immediately '=ln(1+zh)+O(h³)'. The replacement of the summed per-generator log-ratios by ln(1+zh) (rather than 2·ln(1+zh/2)) is a non-obvious step presented as an equality; the factor-of-2/log-additivity bookkeeping is asserted without showing the intermediate identity holds beyond leading order.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: Divergence on three counts: (1) the canonical export proves abstract polynomial identities, not the Q_β bridge with log/remainder the .md states; (2) the analytic Taylor bounds are introduced as `axiom`s rather than proved or honestly `sorry`'d, so `q_beta_spectral_bridge` is sorry-free only because the hard analysis was axiomatized away; (3) the appended BorromeanQuark conditional theorem (the only place Q_beta_A=Q_beta_B appears) is `sorry` over a True-marker class. The Lean does not prove the narrative proposition.

da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict=major-revision. Strongest objection: the proposition's hard content (the analytic Form A≡Form B bridge with O(h²) and the exponential remainder) is not proved — it is split between two standalone `axiom`s (sidestepping the §1a no-axiom-dodge discipline) and a vacuous `BorromeanQuark : Prop where holds:True` + `sorry` conditional, while the sorry-free export proves only abstract ring identities. Compounded by a .ts-vs-.md script/witness mismatch and anchor-ambiguous/selected accuracy figures. The algebraic skeleton is correct, but the block overstates its rigor.
